not_testable.49: The free aggregate-trade and BBO data do not identify individual child orders, queue position, or counterfactual single-order price movement.

source: Official Binance USD-M BTCUSDT aggregate trades and event-level BBO, 2024-01-15
target: log(1 + next-60-second maximum absolute BBO midpoint excursion in bps)
split: first 60% train, next 20% validation for disagreement thresholds, final 20% untouched test

models.parametric_regular: ridge regression using average spread/depth/imbalance, realized volatility, trade volume, signed imbalance, and square-root normalized signed flow
models.nonlinear_regular_control: histogram gradient boosting using exactly the same conventional features
models.breakdown: same nonlinear model plus local minima/last state, event concentration, spectral activity, opposing flow, sensitivity, depth change, rolling impact exponent/convexity/permanence, and cross-scale coupling

disagreement: absolute difference between nonlinear-regular and breakdown predictions, with low/high cutoffs fixed from validation 20th/80th percentiles
primary_gate: breakdown test MAE at least 5% lower than nonlinear-regular control
high-minus-low disagreement conventional absolute error has a strictly positive 95% 10-minute-block bootstrap interval
high-minus-low disagreement breakdown advantage has a strictly positive 95% 10-minute-block bootstrap interval
h47: Past observable nonlinear-regular residual is delayed six bins, averaged over six completed outcomes, and tested as a predictor of current future excursion
interpretation: A pass would show conventional-feature model breakdown, not prove that market participants explicitly use a mathematically incorrect Navier-Stokes assumption. A failure rejects only this operationalization.
